name: Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. produces, supplies, and sells natural gas in Japan. It operates through four segments: Gas, LPG, Electricity and Other Energy, and Real Estate. The Gas segment includes the production, supply, and sale of city gas, sales of gas appliances, gas piping construction, LNG sales, and renovation services. The LPG segment covers the sale of LPG, LPG equipment, and related construction work. The Electricity and Other Energy segment comprises electricity sales, heat supply, and solar power generation, as well as international energy business such as overseas LNG shipments.
